steps.data:
<?php
/**
 * Gratora on WordPress Playground.
 *
 * Playground runs WordPress on SQLite. Gratora is written for MySQL 8 and
 * calls a few functions SQLite does not have, so they are supplied here.
 * Nothing in this file is needed, or loaded, on a real site.
 */

/*
 * A form preview is a sandboxed frame. The Playground serves this site's files
 * from inside the browser, where a sandboxed frame cannot reach: it asks the
 * real server, which has none of them. So a preview carries what it would have
 * linked. Only a document built for a preview is made in a REST request.
 */
$gratora_local = static function ( string $src ): ?string {
	$path = (string) wp_parse_url( $src, PHP_URL_PATH );
	foreach ( array( '/wp-content/', '/wp-includes/' ) as $root ) {
		$at = strpos( $path, $root );
		if ( false === $at ) {
			continue;
		}
		$file = realpath( ABSPATH . ltrim( substr( $path, $at ), '/' ) );

		return ( $file && 0 === strpos( $file, (string) realpath( ABSPATH ) ) && is_readable( $file ) ) ? $file : null;
	}

	return null;
};
add_filter(
	'style_loader_tag',
	static function ( $tag, $handle, $href ) use ( $gratora_local ) {
		$file = ( defined( 'REST_REQUEST' ) && REST_REQUEST ) ? $gratora_local( (string) $href ) : null;
		if ( null === $file ) {
			return $tag;
		}

		return '<style id="' . esc_attr( $handle ) . '-css">' . str_replace( '</style', '<\/style', (string) file_get_contents( $file ) ) . "</style>\n";
	},
	10,
	3
);
add_filter(
	'script_loader_tag',
	static function ( $tag, $handle, $src ) use ( $gratora_local ) {
		$file = ( defined( 'REST_REQUEST' ) && REST_REQUEST ) ? $gratora_local( (string) $src ) : null;
		if ( null === $file ) {
			return $tag;
		}
		$code = str_replace( array( '</script', '<!--' ), array( '<\/script', '<\!--' ), (string) file_get_contents( $file ) );

		return (string) preg_replace_callback(
			'#<script\b([^>]*?)\ssrc=(["\'])[^"\']*\2([^>]*)></script>#',
			static fn ( array $m ): string => '<script' . $m[1] . $m[3] . '>' . $code . '</script>',
			(string) $tag,
			1
		);
	},
	10,
	3
);

global $wpdb;

$gratora_pdo = null;
if ( isset( $wpdb->dbh ) && is_object( $wpdb->dbh ) ) {
	if ( method_exists( $wpdb->dbh, 'get_connection' ) ) {
		$gratora_pdo = $wpdb->dbh->get_connection()->get_pdo();
	} elseif ( method_exists( $wpdb->dbh, 'get_pdo' ) ) {
		$gratora_pdo = $wpdb->dbh->get_pdo();
	}
}
if ( ! $gratora_pdo instanceof PDO ) {
	return;
}

$gratora_sql = static function ( string $name, callable $fn, int $args ) use ( $gratora_pdo ): void {
	if ( class_exists( 'Pdo\Sqlite' ) && $gratora_pdo instanceof Pdo\Sqlite ) {
		$gratora_pdo->createFunction( $name, $fn, $args );

		return;
	}
	// Deprecated in PHP 8.5 in favor of the class above, which a plain PDO connection is not.
	@$gratora_pdo->sqliteCreateFunction( $name, $fn, $args ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.PHP.NoSilencedErrors.Discouraged
};

// SQLite's json_extract already hands back bare text.
$gratora_sql( 'JSON_UNQUOTE', static fn ( $value ) => null === $value ? null : (string) $value, 1 );

// MySQL's atomic counter: LAST_INSERT_ID(expr) keeps a value, LAST_INSERT_ID() reads it back.
$gratora_kept = null;
$gratora_sql(
	'LAST_INSERT_ID',
	static function ( $value ) use ( &$gratora_kept ) {
		$gratora_kept = $value;

		return $value;
	},
	1
);
$gratora_sql(
	'LAST_INSERT_ID',
	static function () use ( &$gratora_kept, $gratora_pdo ) {
		return null !== $gratora_kept ? $gratora_kept : (int) $gratora_pdo->lastInsertId();
	},
	0
);

// Months between two periods written as YYYYMM.
$gratora_sql(
	'PERIOD_DIFF',
	static function ( $a, $b ) {
		if ( null === $a || null === $b ) {
			return null;
		}
		$months = static fn ( $p ): int => intdiv( (int) $p, 100 ) * 12 + ( (int) $p % 100 );

		return $months( $a ) - $months( $b );
	},
	2
);

// The queue is slow to wake in a browser, so each request runs the Gratora jobs it queued (receipts, emails).
add_action(
	'shutdown',
	static function (): void {
		if ( ! function_exists( 'as_get_scheduled_actions' ) || ! did_action( 'action_scheduler_init' ) ) {
			return;
		}
		$due = as_get_scheduled_actions(
			array(
				'group'    => 'gratora',
				'status'   => ActionScheduler_Store::STATUS_PENDING,
				'date'     => as_get_datetime_object(),
				'per_page' => 20,
			)
		);
		foreach ( $due as $id => $action ) {
			if ( 0 === strpos( $action->get_hook(), 'gratora.async.' ) ) {
				ActionScheduler::runner()->process_action( $id, 'Playground' );
			}
		}
	},
	100
);

steps.code:
<?php
/**
 * Fill the sandbox: a year of sample fundraising, then test mode, so a visitor
 * can give on a campaign page with the test payment method and no money moves.
 */

require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

use Gratora\Campaigns\CampaignService;
use Gratora\Cli\DemoSeeder;
use Gratora\Donations\AggregateSyncer;
use Gratora\Donations\DonationService;
use Gratora\Donors\DonorService;
use Gratora\Foundation\Plugin;
use Gratora\Foundation\Time\Clock;
use Gratora\Funds\FundService;
use Gratora\Recurring\RecurringPlanRepository;
use Gratora\Settings\SettingsService;

$c = Plugin::instance()->container;

( new DemoSeeder(
	$c->get( DonationService::class ),
	$c->get( DonorService::class ),
	$c->get( CampaignService::class ),
	$c->get( FundService::class ),
	$c->get( AggregateSyncer::class ),
	$c->get( RecurringPlanRepository::class ),
	$c->get( Clock::class )
) )->run( static function (): void {} );

// What "Just exploring" does on the setup screen.
$c->get( SettingsService::class )->update( 'gateways', array( 'test_mode' => true ) );
update_option( 'gratora_onboarding_status', 'completed', false );

// A demo visitor is not asked to review the plugin.
foreach ( get_users( array( 'role' => 'administrator', 'fields' => 'ID' ) ) as $admin ) {
	update_user_meta( (int) $admin, 'gratora_review_prompt', 'never' );
}
